**Comparison 1 (3D Model):**
Yes, the sinking problem has been fixed. In Image 2, the model rests cleanly **on top of** the grid (supported by visible feet/pads), whereas in Image 1 it was intersecting/sunk into the grid floor.

**Comparison 2 (Flowsheet):**
Yes, the layout issue has been resolved. In Image 4, the flowsheet is now displayed as **one single, coherent diagram** within a unified view, whereas Image 3 showed the content awkwardly split across three separate, boxed sections.
